repo_notes.content: Personal utility-script collection: standalone tools grouped in per-topic directories, no shared build system. Mostly Ruby, plus Python and POSIX shell scripts.

CloneCD/clonecd_batch_help.rb converts MODE1/2352 and MODE2/2352 disc images (.ccd/.img/.cue sets) to proper ISO files, scanning current dir + subdirs with parallel processing; depends on bchunk (brew).
erc_scraper/ scrapes ERC course pages (Mechanize) into an RSS feed XML; run_erc_scraper.sh also uploads the result to a server. erc_course/ is an earlier standalone variant of the same scraper.

Jekyll/, Joomla/scripts/, and Shell/ hold reusable helpers extracted from other projects: dead-link hygiene for Jekyll sites, a Joomla extension integration-test toolkit, and shell test/coverage/version templates.

startstop/ is a self-contained mini-project (own Gemfile + lib/*.json data) that builds startstop.html, a geriatric medication StartStop list page. Root-level calibra_ocr_ebook.sh is a standalone Tesseract+Calibre OCR pipeline.
Quality: SonarCloud + CodeFactor badges; sonar-project.properties and .semgrepignore at root. See README.md plus the per-tool README files for usage.

pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: Repository purpose and layout — a collection of standalone helper scripts grouped by topic rather than a single application

pages.title: CloneCD Batch Converter
pages.purpose: CloneCD/clonecd_batch_help.rb: input formats (ccd/img/cue, MODE1/MODE2 2352), ISO conversion via bchunk, parallel traversal of directories

pages.title: ERC Scrapers
pages.purpose: erc_scraper/ (erc_course.rb + run_erc_scraper.sh): scraping ERC course pages into RSS XML and uploading the feed to a server; erc_course/ is the earlier standalone variant

pages.title: Jekyll Utilities
pages.purpose: Jekyll/: link_hygiene_scan.rb probes external links and writes a JSON plan, link_hygiene_apply.rb rewrites dead links to web.archive.org and upgrades live ones, install-hooks.sh enables tracked git hooks

pages.title: Joomla Test Toolkit
pages.purpose: Joomla/scripts/: reusable integration-test toolkit for Joomla extensions — install/uninstall via the admin web installer, db-query.php and bootstrap.php inside containers, php-diagnostics.sh, and pcov coverage collection/merge scripts

pages.title: Shell Helpers
pages.purpose: Shell/: reusable POSIX sh templates — test-helpers.sh (pass/fail logging for integration suites), kcov-coverage.sh (Cobertura XML via a throwaway container), update-version.sh (single-source versions.env freshness gate)

pages.title: Media Tools
pages.purpose: MP4VobSub2SRT/subtitles.rb (MP4Box + vobsub2srt subtitle extraction from MP4) and calibra_ocr_ebook.sh (Tesseract + Calibre ebook-convert OCR pipeline for PDFs/ebooks)

pages.title: Periodicals Metadata
pages.purpose: periodicals/: periodicals-getmeta.rb — interactive PDF metadata tool (OCR fallback, ISSN checksum validation, Crossref/Wikidata lookup, XMP/PRISM embed via exiftool, resumable state.jsonl) plus renamer_national_geopraphic.rb

pages.title: Zotero2Mendeley
pages.purpose: Zotero2Mendeley/: scripts (converter.py, convert2.py, convert3.py, Zotero2Mendeley.rb) converting Zotero citations embedded in .docx files to Mendeley format

pages.title: StartStop Generator
pages.purpose: startstop/: build_all.rb renders startstop.html from lib/*.json drug data and lib/template.html; its own Gemfile/lockfile make it a self-contained sub-project
